description: Evidence authority is independent of file transport. Class ranks preventive claims; representation is a separate field.

platform.meaning: Exported control-plane state. Resolves existence, attachment and enforcement.

document.meaning: Intent, design, process, or infrastructure definition. Cannot by itself prove a control is currently enforced.

workshop.meaning: Operating-model knowledge and evidence leads. Cannot replace platform evidence or become a finding by itself.

authority_rules: An uploaded control-plane export remains Class 1 even though it was not collected through a live connection.
A design document remains Class 2 and cannot, by itself, prove that a control is currently enforced.
A workshop response remains Class 3 and cannot replace platform evidence.
Class 3 cannot award Embedded for a missing preventive control.
Knowledge Base and Tactic Playbook records are not customer evidence.
